Find A B if \triangle A B C is an isosceles triangle.
Choices:
A:3
B:4
C:7
D:11

audit.source_question:
Find A B if \triangle A B C is an isosceles triangle.
Choices:
A:3
B:4
C:7
D:11

adaptation.reason: Clarified which sides are equal. The source term isosceles alone also admits a different positive solution with AC=BC; the intended apex in the drawing is B.

audit.independent_solution: The isosceles equal sides are AB and BC, so 2x−7=4x−21 and x=7. Hence AB=2·7−7=7 (C).
audit.geometry_notes: Coordinates were analytically constructed from explicit given conditions; unknown side values are used only to freeze the diagram and are not exposed as labels. Original vertex order, edge connections, labels and relation marks are retained.
